name: frontend
description: Design and critique UI structure (layouts, flows, components, patterns), answer motion questions from a cited corpus (motion-rules), verify it all against non-functional bars (focus, i18n, perf, safety), and capture per-shape UI-feature ticket intake schemas (feature-intake-rules) — plus check-ui-change, which drives the live artifact instead of reasoning about it in the abstract.
